from typing import Literal
import mas_operators as operator
from . import prompt as prompt_custom
from scripts.async_llm import create_llm_instance


from scripts.evaluator import DatasetType

class Workflow:
    def __init__(
        self,
        name: str,
        llm_config,
        dataset: DatasetType,
        aggregator_llm_config=None,
    ) -> None:
        self.name = name
        self.dataset = dataset
        self.llm = create_llm_instance(llm_config)
        self.aggregator_llm = create_llm_instance(aggregator_llm_config) if aggregator_llm_config else self.llm

    async def __call__(self, problem: str):
        star = operator.Star(
            worker_llm=self.llm,
            aggregator_llm=self.aggregator_llm,
            num_agents=3,
            worker_prompts=[prompt_custom.WORKER_ROW_FIRST_STAR, prompt_custom.WORKER_COL_FIRST_STAR, prompt_custom.WORKER_ENDPOINT_DRIVEN_STAR],
            aggregator_prompt=prompt_custom.AGGREGATOR_STAGE1_COLLECT,
        )
        stage1 = await star(problem)
        debate = operator.Debate(
            worker_llm=self.llm,
            aggregator_llm=self.aggregator_llm,
            num_agents=3,
            worker_prompts=[prompt_custom.WORKER_VALIDATE_REPAIR_DEBATE, prompt_custom.WORKER_VALIDATE_REPAIR_DEBATE, prompt_custom.WORKER_VALIDATE_REPAIR_DEBATE],
            aggregator_prompt=prompt_custom.AGGREGATOR_STRICT_MAZE_PICK,
            n_rounds=2,
        )
        enriched_problem = problem + "\n\nStage-1 candidate paths:\n" + (stage1.get("response") or "No candidate produced.")
        solution = await debate(enriched_problem)
        return solution.get("response") or "```text\nnot exist the path from start to end.\n```", {
            "worker": self.llm.get_usage_delta(),
            "aggregator": self.aggregator_llm.get_usage_delta(),
        }
